fact: Law n° 029/2023 of 14/06/2023 governing population registration in the national single digital identity system, published in the Official Gazette on 15/06/2023 and in force on publication, repeals Law 14/2008 and provides for biometric capture and a unique permanent SDID number.
title: Law n° 029/2023 of 14/06/2023 governing population registration in the national single digital identity system
publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of Rwanda
